How does the hourly wage converter work?

The converter first finds regular annual gross pay from your input. It then derives the equivalent amounts for each pay period. Your work schedule changes the result.

Hourly wage to annual salary

Hourly rate × hours per week × paid weeks

Use your regular schedule and subtract any unpaid weeks.

$25 × 40 × 52 = $52,000

Annual salary to hourly wage

Annual salary ÷ annual scheduled hours

A 40-hour week over 52 weeks adds up to 2,080 hours.

$60,000 ÷ 2,080 = $28.85/hr

What is a 2,080-hour work year?

40 hours × 52 weeks = 2,080 scheduled hours. This is a useful baseline. Your schedule may be different. Paid leave and hours actually worked are separate questions. Read the full guide on how many work hours are in a year.

How unpaid time off changes earnings

Unpaid weeks reduce annual earnings for hourly work. Paid vacation that replaces regular paid hours does not need to be subtracted.

Hourly pay vs. salary

Hourly paySalary
Earnings depend on paid hoursAnnual compensation is the starting point
A changed schedule can change earningsThe same salary can cover different work schedules
Paid leave depends on the arrangementPaid leave can reduce time worked without reducing salary
Overtime pay can apply after 40 hours in a weekOvertime often does not apply to exempt salaried roles

The pay label alone does not determine overtime eligibility. Compare expected hours, paid leave, benefits, and any additional earnings.

Do you work overtime?

If extra hours are paid at another rate, calculate them separately. At a $25 regular rate, 1.5× means $37.50 per overtime hour. Use the overtime calculator to compare rates and extra hours.

Our calculation method

Visible assumptions. Checkable formulas.

Hourly annual pay is rate × regular weekly hours × paid weeks. Salary-to-hourly divides the stated annual salary by those hours. Overtime is extra. Values retain full precision until display. Read our calculation methodology.

Your calculation stays in your browser

The calculator processes your entries on your device. No account or wage submission is needed. Read about calculator privacy.

Frequently asked questions

How do I convert hourly pay to annual salary?

Multiply your hourly rate by your regular hours per week and paid weeks per year. At $25 an hour for 40 hours a week over 52 weeks, gross annual pay is $52,000.

How much is $20 an hour per year?

$20 an hour equals $41,600 a year at 40 hours a week for 52 paid weeks. That is $800 per week and an average of $3,466.67 per month before taxes.

How much is $25 an hour per year?

$25 an hour equals $52,000 a year under a 40-hour week and 52 paid weeks. If two weeks are unpaid, the same schedule produces $50,000.

How much is $30 an hour per year?

$30 an hour equals $62,400 a year at 40 hours a week for 52 paid weeks. It averages $5,200 a month before taxes and deductions.
